# 1. Setup

## - Setting work directories

Defining work directory within rmarkdown chunk

```{r setup, include=TRUE}
local_wd_folder = dirname(dirname(dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path)))
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = local_wd_folder)
```

```{r}
setwd(local_wd_folder)
```

## - Setting seed

This step ensures reproducibility in randomized processes

```{r}
set.seed(seed = 123, kind = "Mersenne-Twister", normal.kind = "Inversion")
```

## - Options

```{r}
options(Seurat.object.assay.version = 'v3')
```

## - Loading libraries

```{r}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(Seurat)
library(scuttle)
library(scater)
library(dplyr)

```

```{r}
data_folder = paste0(local_wd_folder, '/Data/10x')

Input_data = paste(data_folder, '/Per_Sample_Demultiplexed_Mapped_Data', sep = '')
```

## - Loading palettes

```{r}
# Load additional colour palette packages
library(unikn, quietly = TRUE)
library(RColorBrewer, quietly = TRUE)
library(yarrr, quietly = TRUE)
library(scales, quietly = TRUE)
library(ggsci, quietly = TRUE)

# Define a set of custom color palettes from the unikn package
mix_1 <- usecol(pal = c(Karpfenblau, "white", Peach), n = 15)
mix_2 <- usecol(pal = c(rev(pal_seeblau), "white", pal_pinky))
mix_3 <- usecol(pal = c(rev(pal_bordeaux), "white", pal_petrol), n = 15)

# Display the custom palettes
seecol(list(mix_1, mix_2, mix_3), col_brd = "white", lwd_brd = 4, title = "Comparing palettes mixed from unikn colors", pal_names = c("mix_1", "mix_2", "mix_3"))

# Define a second set of custom palettes from the RColorBrewer and yarrr packages
brew_mix <- usecol(c(rev(brewer.pal(n = 4, name = "Reds")), "white", brewer.pal(n = 4, name = "Blues")), n = 13)
brew_ext <- usecol(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "Spectral"), n = 12)
yarrr_mix <- usecol(c(piratepal("nemo"), piratepal("bugs")))
yarrr_mod <- usecol(c(piratepal("ipod")), n = 9)

gradient_exp <- rev(c('#FFAB01', '#FC8805', '#FC5D05', '#D92211', "#D9043D", "#A6036D", "#7C038C", "#5503A6", "#A69AEE", '#D9D4F7', "#FFFFFF", "#F4F7FF", '#E9EBEF'))

# Display the second set of custom palettes
seecol(pal = list(brew_mix, brew_ext, yarrr_mix, yarrr_mod), col_brd = "white", lwd_brd = 2, title = "Using usecol() and seecol() to mix and modify palettes", pal_names = c("brew_mix", "brew_ext", "yarrr_mix", "yarrr_mod"))

# Define additional custom palettes from the scales package
natjournals_palette <- pal_npg("nrc")(10)
```

# 2. INPUT: Importing pre-filtered samples

```{r}
Merged.SeuratObj <- readRDS(paste(data_folder, 'SC_Objects', 'Added_VDJ.rds', sep = '/'))

df_bcr <- read.table(file.path(results_folder, 'VDJ', 'Comprehensive_sc_metadata_with_BCR.tsv'), 
  sep = "\t", header = T, check.names = FALSE)
```

# 3. Classification

```{r}
# =========================================
# 2. Define Antigen Columns
# =========================================

wt_cols  <- c("Spike-1-WT", "Spike-2-WT", "RBD-WT", "NTD-WT")
bti_cols <- c("Spike-1-BTI", "Spike-2-BTI", "RBD-BTI", "NTD-BTI")
all_antigens <- c(wt_cols, bti_cols)

# =========================================
# 2b. Flag Known Contaminated Runs (WT only)
# =========================================

df_bcr <- df_bcr %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    contaminated = Identity %in% c(
      # RBD-WT contaminated runs
      "VA013_T8_GB",
      "VA013_T8_Ambiguous",
      # NTD-WT contaminated runs
      "VA013_T5_GB",
      "VA013_T5_Ambiguous",
      "VA025_T5_GB",
      "VA025_T5_Ambiguous",
      "VA025_T8_GB",
      "VA025_T8_Ambiguous"
    )
  )

# =========================================
# 3. Classify Rows
# =========================================

df_bcr <- df_bcr %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    n_positive = sum(c_across(all_of(all_antigens)) > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    wt_positive  = any(c_across(all_of(wt_cols))  > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    bti_positive = any(c_across(all_of(bti_cols)) > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    rbd_positive = any(c_across(c("RBD-WT", "RBD-BTI")) > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    ntd_positive = any(c_across(c("NTD-WT", "NTD-BTI")) > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    rbd_wt  = `RBD-WT`  > 0,
    rbd_bti = `RBD-BTI` > 0,
    ntd_wt  = `NTD-WT`  > 0,
    ntd_bti = `NTD-BTI` > 0,
    
    domain_mismatch = (
      (rbd_wt  & !rbd_bti & bti_positive) |
        (rbd_bti & !rbd_wt  & wt_positive)  |
        (ntd_wt  & !ntd_bti & bti_positive) |
        (ntd_bti & !ntd_wt  & wt_positive)
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    logic = case_when(
      contaminated ~ "contaminated",
      n_positive == 0 ~ "negative",
      `CTRL.1` > 0 ~ "background",
      n_positive < 2 ~ "background",
      rbd_positive & ntd_positive ~ "impossible",
      wt_positive & bti_positive & domain_mismatch ~ "improbable",
      TRUE ~ "clear"
    ),
    
    strain = case_when(
      logic %in% c("background","impossible","negative","contaminated") ~ NA_character_,
      wt_positive & !bti_positive ~ "WT",
      bti_positive & !wt_positive ~ "BTI",
      wt_positive & bti_positive  ~ "Bispecific",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    region = case_when(
      logic != "clear" ~ NA_character_,
      rbd_positive ~ "RBD",
      ntd_positive ~ "NTD",
      TRUE ~ "Spike only"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-n_positive, -wt_positive, -bti_positive,
         -rbd_positive, -ntd_positive,
         -rbd_wt, -rbd_bti, -ntd_wt, -ntd_bti,
         -domain_mismatch)

write.csv(
  df_bcr,
  file = file.path(results_folder, "VDJ", "BCR_data_integrated_classified.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

# =========================================
# 4. Summarize Clones
# =========================================
# ---- 4a. Identify "clear" clones appearing >= 2 times ----

clear_clones <- df_bcr %>%
  filter(logic == "clear") %>%
  count(clone_id) %>%
  filter(n >= 2) %>%
  pull(clone_id)

# ---- 4b. Clone x logic summary ----
clone_summary <- df_bcr %>%
  filter(clone_id %in% clear_clones) %>%
  count(clone_id, logic) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = logic, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  arrange(clone_id)

cat("=== All clones appearing >= 2 times in 'clear' ===\n")

write.csv(
  clone_summary,
  file = file.path(results_folder, "VDJ", "Clone_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

# ---- 4c. Clone x region summary ----
clone_region_summary <- df_bcr %>%
  filter(clone_id %in% clear_clones) %>%
  count(clone_id, region) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = region, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    multi = ifelse(sum(c_across(c("NTD", "Spike only", "RBD")) > 0) > 1, "Y", "N")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("=== All clones appearing >= 2 times in 'clear' (region) ===\n")

write.csv(
  clone_region_summary,
  file = file.path(results_folder, "VDJ", "Clone_region_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

# ---- 4d. Clone x Donor matrix ----
clone_donor_matrix <- df_bcr %>%
  filter(clone_id %in% clear_clones) %>%
  count(clone_id, Donor) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Donor, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    multi = ifelse(sum(c_across(-clone_id) > 0) > 1, "Y", "N")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("=== Clone x Donor matrix (multi indicates clone in multiple donors) ===\n")

write.csv(
  clone_donor_matrix,
  file = file.path(results_folder, "VDJ", "Clone_donor_matrix.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

# =========================================
# 5. Identify Clones to Rescue
# =========================================

rescue_clones <- clone_region_summary %>%
  filter(multi == "N") %>%
  pull(clone_id)

# =========================================
# 6. Create Rescued Dataframe
# =========================================

eligible_for_rescue <- df_bcr %>%
  filter(clone_id %in% rescue_clones & 
           logic %in% c("background","improbable","impossible","negative","contaminated"))

clone_reference <- df_bcr %>%
  filter(clone_id %in% rescue_clones & logic == "clear") %>%
  select(clone_id, strain, region) %>%
  group_by(clone_id) %>%
  summarise(
    strain_ref = first(na.omit(strain)),
    region_ref = first(na.omit(region)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

rescued_rows <- eligible_for_rescue %>%
  left_join(clone_reference, by = "clone_id") %>%
  mutate(
    logic = "rescued",
    strain = strain_ref,
    region = region_ref
  ) %>%
  select(-strain_ref, -region_ref)

df_bcr_rescued <- df_bcr %>%
  filter(!(clone_id %in% rescue_clones & 
             logic %in% c("background","improbable","impossible","negative","contaminated"))) %>%
  bind_rows(rescued_rows)

n_rescued <- sum(df_bcr_rescued$logic == "rescued")
cat("Number of rows updated to 'rescued':", n_rescued, "\n")

write.csv(
  df_bcr_rescued,
  file = file.path(results_folder, "VDJ", "BCR_data_integrated_classified_with_rescued.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

# =========================================
# 7. Summarize and Plot Logic Classification
# =========================================

# Tableau 10 color panel
tableau10_colors <- c(
  "steelblue4", "darkorange1", "brown3", "lightseagreen",
  "forestgreen", "gold1", "darkorchid2", "palevioletred1",
  "lightsalmon4", "seashell3"
)

# Tableau color blind panel
tableau_cb_colors <- c(
  "dodgerblue4", "chocolate1", "slategray3", "grey30",
  "cornflowerblue", "orangered3", "lightsteelblue4", "skyblue",
  "bisque1", "azure3"
)

if("dataset" %in% colnames(df_bcr_rescued)) {
  logic_summary <- df_bcr_rescued %>%
    count(dataset, logic)
} else {
  logic_summary <- df_bcr_rescued %>%
    count(logic) %>%
    mutate(dataset = "All Data")
}

ggplot(logic_summary, aes(x = logic, y = n, fill = logic)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", width = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ dataset, ncol = 1) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = tableau_cb_colors) +
  theme_prism(base_size = 10) +
  labs(
    title = "Breakdown of Logic Classification",
    x = "Logic Category",
    y = "Number of Rows",
    fill = "Logic"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title   = element_text(family = "Arial", size = 20, face = "plain", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title   = element_text(family = "Arial", size = 16, face = "plain"),
    axis.text    = element_text(family = "Arial", size = 14, face = "plain"),
    strip.text   = element_text(family = "Arial", size = 18, face = "plain"),
    legend.title = element_text(family = "Arial", size = 16, face = "plain"),
    legend.text  = element_text(family = "Arial", size = 14, face = "plain"),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0))

# Add data back

rownames(df_bcr_rescued) <- df_bcr_rescued$cell_id

Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data[,'contaminated'] <- df_bcr_rescued[rownames(Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data),'contaminated']
Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data[,'logic'] <- df_bcr_rescued[rownames(Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data),'logic']
Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data[,'strain'] <- df_bcr_rescued[rownames(Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data),'strain']
Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data[,'region'] <- df_bcr_rescued[rownames(Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data),'region']
```

# 4. Memory subclustering

```{r}
Merged.SeuratObj.Memory <- subset(Merged.SeuratObj, cells = WhichCells(Merged.SeuratObj, expression = Celltype %in% c('Class switched memory B-cells', 'Atypical memory B-cells')))

Run_S1081_L364A.SeuratObj.Memory <- subset(Merged.SeuratObj.Memory, cells = WhichCells(Merged.SeuratObj.Memory, expression = Run %in% 'S1081_L364A'))

Run_S1146_L364B.SeuratObj.Memory <- subset(Merged.SeuratObj.Memory, cells = WhichCells(Merged.SeuratObj.Memory, expression = Run %in% 'S1146_L364B'))

Run_S1146_L364C.SeuratObj.Memory <- subset(Merged.SeuratObj.Memory, cells = WhichCells(Merged.SeuratObj.Memory, expression = Run %in% 'S1146_L364C'))

Run_S1146_L364D.SeuratObj.Memory <- subset(Merged.SeuratObj.Memory, cells = WhichCells(Merged.SeuratObj.Memory, expression = Run %in% 'S1146_L364D'))
```

```{r}
Ig_genes <- read.table(file.path(results_folder, "QC", 
                             "Expression", "Immunoglobulin_genes.txt"), header = T)$IG_Genes

VarGenes <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(
  list(Run_S1081_L364A.SeuratObj.Memory, 
       Run_S1146_L364B.SeuratObj.Memory,
       Run_S1146_L364C.SeuratObj.Memory,
       Run_S1146_L364D.SeuratObj.Memory),
  nfeatures = 4000,
  assay = rep('SCT',4),
  verbose = TRUE,
  fvf.nfeatures = 4000,
)

VarGenes.No.IG <- VarGenes[grep(FALSE, VarGenes %in% unique(c(Ig_genes)))][1:3000]

write.table(x = VarGenes.No.IG, quote = F, 
            row.names = F, col.names = 'Variable_Genes',
            file = file.path(results_folder, "QC", 
                             "Expression", "Variable_genes_B_memory.txt"))
```

```{r}
)

digest::digest(Merged.SeuratObj.Memory@reductions$pca@cell.embeddings)
#93192ae38fba3cb51042d45a3e837085

elbow_plot <- ElbowPlot(object = Merged.SeuratObj.Memory, ndims = 40)

print(elbow_plot)
```

```{r}
seed.use = 123

Merged.SeuratObj.Memory <- RunUMAP(Merged.SeuratObj.Memory, dims=1:11, reduction = 'pca', 
                            reduction.name = 'umap', reduction.key = 'umap', 
                            spread=0.35, min.dist=0.75, n.neighbors=50, 
                            n.epochs = 200, return.model = T, seed.use = 123)
```

```{r}
seed.use = 123

Merged.SeuratObj.Memory <- RunHarmony(Merged.SeuratObj.Memory, 
                               group.by.vars = c('Timepoint', 'Donor', 'Identity'), 
                               lambda=c(0.5,1,1),
                               dims.use = 1:11, max_iter = 50)
```

```{r}
seed.use = 123

Merged.SeuratObj.Memory <- RunUMAP(Merged.SeuratObj.Memory, dims=1:11, reduction = 'harmony', 
                            reduction.name = 'h_umap', reduction.key = 'h_umap', 
                            spread=0.35, min.dist=0.75, n.neighbors=50,

```

```{r}
set.seed(123)

Merged.SeuratObj.Memory <- FindNeighbors(Merged.SeuratObj.Memory, assay = 'harmony')

set.seed(123)

Merged.SeuratObj.Memory <- FindClusters(Merged.SeuratObj.Memory, algorithm=4, resolution = 0.2, random.seed = 123)

DimPlot(Merged.SeuratObj.Memory, group.by = 'seurat_clusters', label = T, reduction = 'h_umap')
```

```{r}
DEGs <- FindAllMarkers(Merged.SeuratObj.Memory)

DEGs$pct.2_v_1 <- DEGs$pct.2 - DEGs$pct.1

top50_by_cluster <- DEGs %>%
  mutate(pct.2_v_1 = `pct.1` - `pct.2`) %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct.2_v_1), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 50) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
Merged.SeuratObj.Memory@meta.data[activated_cells,'Celltype'] <- 'Class switched memory B-cells activated'
```
